statement: Texas imposes no corporate income tax, but every taxable entity formed or doing business in Texas owes the annual franchise (margin) tax report, due May 15 (next business day if May 15 falls on a weekend or holiday); for report years 2026-2027 the no-tax-due threshold is $2,650,000 of annualized total revenue ($2,470,000 for 2024-2025), with rates of 0.375% (retail or wholesale) and 0.75% (other) above it, and entities at or below the threshold still file the Public Information Report or Ownership Report.
caveat: Thresholds are indexed and change every two report years; the margin computation (total revenue less the greatest of COGS, compensation, 30%, or $1M) and the 0.331% EZ computation under $20M are not carded here. Failure to file leads to forfeiture notices (Forms 05-212/05-213). Verify against the live Comptroller page and Tax Code Chapter 171 — the statute host serves a JS-only shell to non-browser clients.
